name: case_11
prompt: An East African savanna at sunset. A dusty red-earth trail runs through golden-brown grassland. To the left, a shallow watering hole with muddy brown water reflects the orange sky; a small group of dark animals drink at its edge. Scattered flat-topped acacia trees dot the landscape. To the right, tall golden grass partially conceals a fallen dead acacia trunk bleached grey-white on the ground, its bare branches jutting upward. In the far background, a rugged mountain range with purple-grey slopes stretches across the horizon under a dramatic sunset sky of orange, pink, and violet clouds. Warm golden-hour light bathes the entire scene. Closer to the watering hole on the left, a muddy bank with elephant footprints leads down to the water's edge where a half-submerged log protrudes. Beyond the fallen acacia trunk to the right, a termite mound roughly a meter tall rises from the grass. Behind the initial viewpoint, the red-earth trail curves back toward a sparse cluster of acacia trees where a pair of warthogs graze in the fading light. A large adult African elephant with dark grey wrinkled skin, large fan-shaped ears, and long ivory tusks. Swings its trunk side to side while walking. Third-person view from directly behind the elephant at a mid-height angle, following the animal as the central subject along the trail.
